Actress Akanksha Chamola discusses divorce from Gaurav Khanna on reality show

Actress Akanksha Chamola has revealed on the reality show 'Lock Upp 2' that she is divorcing her husband, Gaurav Khanna. Chamola cited personal reasons, including a lack of maternal desire, as contributing factors to the separation after a decade of marriage. The announcement has generated significant public and media attention, with some speculating about publicity stunts and others focusing on Chamola's personal choices.
